name: Abdominal supra
directions: Supine CRUNCH, knees bent and both feet flat fixed on floor. Hands resting lightly on upper chest, elbows relaxed. Start shoulders on floor then curl just head/shoulder blades a short distance off floor toward knees. Lower back/hips stay supported, NOT full situp, no neck pulling.
instructions: Suba tirando as escápulas do chão.
